title: IBM i (AS/400 / iSeries) Developer - (Contract)
description:
**IBM i (AS/400 / iSeries) Developer**

  

  

  

We are seeking an experienced IBM i (AS/400 / iSeries) Developer to join our developmentteam. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with COBOL/400, RPGLE,CLLE, CBLLE, DB2/400 (DB2400\), SQLRPGLE, SQLCBLLE, triggers, stored procedures, anddevelopment tools such as RDi. You will work in an Agile/Scrum environment, write unit tests,and use version control to deliver reliable enhancements and new functionality for mission\-critical business applications.

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities** Design, develop, test, and maintain IBM i applications using COBOL/400 (CBLLE), RPGLE,and CLLE. Implement and optimize DB2 for i (DB2400\) programs, including SQLRPGLE and SQL inCOBOL (SQLCBLLE). Create, maintain, and troubleshoot triggers, stored procedures, and database objects. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprints, sprint planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives,demos). Write unit tests and support automated or manual testing efforts to ensure code quality. Use Rational Developer for i (RDi) for development, debugging, and code reviews. Follow version control processes (Git, SVN, or other agreed systems), manage branches, andperform code merges. Analyze requirements, estimate tasks, and produce technical design documents. Support production troubleshooting, debug issues, and provide timely fixes. Mentor junior developers and share best practices for IBM i development and databasedesign.

  

  

  

**Required Skills \& Experience** 5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing on IBM i (AS/400, iSeries). Strong proficiency in COBOL/400 (CBLLE) and RPGLE (including free\-form RPG). Solid experience with CL (CLLE) programming and job control on IBM i. Experience with DB2 for i (DB2400\), writing efficient SQL queries, SQLRPGLE, andSQLCBLLE. Hands\-on experience creating and maintaining triggers and stored procedures. Familiarity with Rational Developer for i (RDi) or similar IDEs. Practical experience working in Agile/Scrum teams. Experience with unit testing frameworks or practices for IBM i code. Proficient with version control systems (Git preferred) and branching/merging workflows. Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and good communication skills.environment.

title: Software Engineer - Python
description:
**About Gartner IT:**

Join a world\-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting\-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome\-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.


**About the role:**

Join our Agentic AI Applications team to build intelligent digital assistants for Gartner's Sales and Service teams. You'll develop multi\-agent AI systems using RAG, orchestration frameworks, and LLMs to help associates prepare for client interactions and deliver better results. This role bridges AI engineering and product delivery—from POC to high\-availability production.


**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Build multi\-agent architectures that autonomously retrieve, synthesize, and act on client data and business intelligence.
* Engineer RAG pipelines that aggregate client priorities, communication history, and value metrics for real\-time context.
* Implement workflows that connect disparate systems and route tasks to specialized sub\-agents or APIs.
* Build guardrails, security controls, and intent recognition to ensure safe handling of sensitive data.
* Scale AI capabilities from experimental POCs to robust, production systems serving thousands of users.
* Optimize LLM interactions and context usage to balance latency, cost, and response quality.
* Collaborate with senior engineers, product, and data science teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.

**What you will need** :


Strong IT professional with 2\-4 yrs of experience in software development using Python. The candidate should have strong problem\-solving skills along with high on ownership and accountability.


**Must have:**

2–4 years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code.


* Strong Python proficiency (FastAPI, async programming, performance optimization).
* Strong skills for querying, designing, and optimizing databases.
* Hands\-on experience building AI applications with LangGraph or LangChain and RAG using vector databases.
* Experience designing and deploying scalable AWS solutions (Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway).
* Familiarity with distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and container orchestration.
* Experience transitioning complex systems from POC to production environments.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across global teams.

**Who you are:**
----------------

* Strong time management and ability to meet deadlines.
* Excellent communication with both technical and business audiences.
* Highly organized with strong prioritization and multitasking abilities.
* Eager to learn emerging technologies and rapidly master new concepts.
* Driven by intellectual curiosity and a passion for high\-quality delivery.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.


**Who are we?**

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.


Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.


Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.


**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.


We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.


Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.


We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.


It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.


**What do we offer?**

Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.


In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.


Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

We're a small advanced tech team that takes ideas from "someone had a hunch" to "customers are using it"—usually in days, not sprints. Deep fluency in at least one modern general\-purpose language—and the ability to pick up others quickly. We work across TypeScript/Node, Go, and Python, and you'll touch more than one. title: BI Developer – SSAS & MDX
description:
About This Role
**7 to 10 years of experience**  

**Skills: SSAS, MDX, SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, Power BI, DAX, Data Modelling, ETL, Dimensional Modelling, Star / Snowflake Schema, T\-SQL, Azure Analysis Services, Performance Tuning, Agile**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a Senior BI Developer with 7\-10 years of experience and strong hands\-on expertise in SSAS and MDX to design, build, and maintain enterprise\-grade business intelligence solutions. You will combine deep SSAS Multidimensional and Tabular model expertise with strong MDX and DAX skills — delivering high\-performance analytical solutions that support business decision\-making across the organisation.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain SSAS Multidimensional and Tabular models — building enterprise\-grade analytical cubes and models aligned to business reporting requirements.
* Write and optimise complex MDX queries and calculations — calculated members, named sets, KPIs, and performance\-tuned MDX expressions across SSAS Multidimensional solutions.
* Develop DAX measures and calculated columns for SSAS Tabular models and Power BI — ensuring accurate, performant, and reusable analytical calculations.
* Design and maintain dimensional data models — star and snowflake schemas — aligned to data warehouse and BI best practices.
* Build and maintain ETL pipelines using SSIS — data extraction, transformation, and loading from source systems into the data warehouse and SSAS models.
* Develop SSRS reports and Power BI dashboards — delivering clear, accurate, and actionable business insights from SSAS data sources.
* Conduct SSAS performance tuning — cube partition design, aggregation optimisation, MDX query tuning, and processing performance improvement.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders — gathering reporting requirements and translating them into well\-designed SSAS and BI solutions.
* Support SSAS model upgrades and migrations — including migration from Multidimensional to Tabular or Azure Analysis Services where applicable.
* Produce clear technical documentation — cube design documents, MDX calculation guides, and ETL specifications.

**What We're Looking For**


* 7\-10 years of BI development experience with deep, demonstrable expertise in SSAS and MDX in production enterprise environments.


* Expert\-level SSAS Multidimensional proficiency — cube design, dimension modelling, measure groups, partitions, aggregations, and KPI development.


* Strong MDX skills — complex calculated members, named sets, scoped assignments, and performance\-optimised MDX expressions.


* Solid SSAS Tabular experience — DAX measures, relationships, and tabular model design alongside Multidimensional expertise.


* Advanced T\-SQL and SQL Server skills — complex querying, stored procedures, and query performance tuning for BI and data warehouse workloads.


* Strong dimensional modelling expertise — star / snowflake schema design, slowly changing dimensions, and data warehouse best practices.


* Solid SSIS experience — ETL pipeline design, development, and performance optimisation for data warehouse loading.


* Good Power BI skills — report and dashboard development integrated with SSAS Tabular and Multidimensional data sources.


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — diagnosing SSAS performance issues, MDX query problems, and data quality defects.


* Good communication and stakeholder engagement skills — translating complex BI requirements into well\-designed analytical solutions.
